objective: Estimate the effect of complete attached-component context with matched original reconstruction targets, initialized encoders, exact chunked global attention and frozen biological probes.
name: Matched one-hop versus complete-component context pilot
input_policy: Native 7 structural features with component ID removed, plus the complete frozen 512D NT cache. Same raw values and coordinate/orientation covariates as the Q branch. Frozen NT is never trained.
window_policy: Eligibility fixed by the original one-hop junction loader, split_seed=20260806; use identical retained fold-A train/validation windows in both contexts. Never load test windows in pretraining. No new eligibility, size filtering or reconstruction targets from component expansion.
masking: All 519 input columns replaced by a learned token for a sampled set of biological segment IDs; both oriented handles always hidden together. No random feature replacement. Fresh deterministic mask per training epoch/window; three fixed validation masks.
target_policy: The same original one-hop biological segment IDs in both contexts; train-only unique target moments. Added component nodes are visible context only. Hide every handle of each sampled target segment, including any newly present reverse handle.
decoder: 48D linear projection, zero all masked latent rows, one native bidirectional graph-attention layer and a 512D linear output. No latent residual/copy; full structural graph retained, no edge prediction loss.
loss: Scaled cosine error alpha=2, equal weight per biological segment within a window; training averages windows. Validation weights masked segment counts across the fixed window/mask bank.
selection: Minimum self-supervised validation reconstruction loss only. Random encoder receives identical initialization and decoder optimization; its encoder weights must remain bitwise unchanged.
downstream: Frozen native cCRE and historical INS/DEL probes on fold-A train/validation only. Original manuscript one-hop window eligibility and original oriented-handle pooling occurrences in both contexts. C+S / C+S+E / C+S+H / C+S+H+E, max_iter=4000, saved fitted probes and replay. No test extraction/scoring.
comparisons: full_trained minus full_random within each context
coordinate_trained minus coordinate_random within each context
full_trained minus coordinate_trained within each context
(component full_trained minus full_random) minus (1hop full_trained minus full_random)
decision: Retain all seeds, arms and contexts; report paired development-validation differences without automated promotion, test access or significance/superiority gates. Checkpoints selected only by the reconstruction validation bank.
validity_gates: Checkpoint reload reproduces selected reconstruction score
Downstream target and baseline score identities match
limitations: Exploratory follow-up after failed junction development gates; these remain recorded
Native backbone, grouped masks and standardized targets differ from official GraphMAE
Coordinate covariates remain visible; coordinate-only control required
One development fold cannot establish chromosome generalization
Equal nominal epoch budget does not imply compute equivalence to junction training
No automated promotion or claim of NMI acceptance
Added component nodes remain visible, so the mask fraction among all context nodes is smaller; the target mask fraction is identical.
Context changes encoder/decoder neighborhoods and native per-slice SO/LN scaling, SR min/max and degree normalization; this is a context-pipeline comparison, not an isolated adjacency effect.
Original target population excludes newly represented component-only nodes from reconstruction and biological probes.
Validation also fits probe calibration and thresholds; its scores are exploratory development descriptions.
timing: Fixed before the first wider-context fit; existing chromosome matrix outcomes are not inputs to this design or its execution readiness checks.
compute_budget: 24 pretraining runs: 2 contexts x 4 controls x 3 seeds; maximum 20 epochs and patience 5 per run. 48 frozen biological probes. All runs retained; same window/optimizer budget is not equal wall-clock compute.
dependency_policy: Require a successful CPU all-window preflight for this exact config, the full 120-probe chromosome matrix, 30-probe original-v1 reference, and both largest-context CUDA profile receipts complete before any pilot GPU allocation. Read dependency health/completion only.
